CapStatus.description: Outcome of the growth cap check (SPEC-0006 R8).

oneOf.description: The growth is at or below the cap.
The growth is above the cap: reported, not refused.

GrowthCapCheck.description: The perpetual growth compared with the cap the analyst gave.

cap.description: The cap given, decimal fraction per period.

growth.description: The perpetual growth checked, decimal fraction per period.

TerminalBasis.description: Whether a terminal value is a value of the whole business or of its equity.

oneOf.description:
Enterprise value: flows to all capital providers (FCFF), discounted at the WACC;
multiples EV/EBITDA, EV/EBIT, EV/Sales.

Equity value: flows to shareholders (FCFE, dividends), discounted at the cost of
equity; multiple P/E.

growth_cap.description: Implied growth compared with the cap; `null` when no cap is given.

implied_growth.description:
Perpetual growth implied by the multiple, r − CF_{N+1} / TV_N, decimal fraction per
period; `null` when `rate` and `next_flow` are not given.

terminal_value.description: Terminal value at N, not discounted, in currency units.
